description: This file is a server-side script for a SvelteKit application page, handling data loading and actions (create, update, delete, change status, move) for a tasks list page. It interacts with a Django REST API backend to fetch and manipulate task data and related entities, with logic for filtering, pagination, and transforming API responses for frontend use.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads task data, related entities, and dropdown options from the API, applying filters and pagination based on URL parameters. It handles response transformation for frontend rendering.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new task by sending form data to the API, transforming frontend fields to backend format.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing task with new data, identified by task ID, via PATCH requests to the API.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Updates the status of a task to 'Completed' using a PATCH request.

methods.name: reopen
methods.description: Reopens a task by setting its status back to 'New' via PATCH request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a task by sending a DELETE request to the API.

methods.name: moveTask
methods.description: Moves a task within the list or between stages by sending a PATCH request with position and stage info.
